text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the adoption of a by-law to designate an accessible parking zone on the west side of Wharfside Lane where parking is currently permitted for a maximum period of three hours.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Designated an accessible parking space to operate at all times on the west side of Wharfside Lane, between a point 112 metres south of Bridgend Street and a point 6 metres further south.
